classes.name: LifecycleAdmissionExclusion
classes.owner: Assisted Runner append-only lifecycle admission seam
classes.boundary: An ended run and any incomplete call are mutually exclusive and at most one incomplete call may own a run even when no physical invocation is unresolved.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Fix the existing atomic conflict/reconciliation path rather than adding a lock or scheduler. Production-seam proof must barrier races at call_started-before-navigator_started between Navigator settlement and role reservation and end-versus-call admission; prove no generation or child launch occurs after ended and no staggered second call reaches Navigator or role.

classes.name: NavigatorDecisionInputVisibility
classes.owner: Assisted acquisition to digest-bound Navigator snapshot seam
classes.boundary: Caller-supplied label policy meanings are typed decision-bearing snapshot input visible to Navigator and bound by the snapshot digest.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Add the validated policy mapping to the canonical snapshot contract and acquisition result. Production-seam proof must show two mappings over identical raw labels produce distinct bound snapshots and that the active Navigator input receives the selected mapping without prose inference.

classes.name: TrackerNullBodyNormalization
classes.boundary: A valid GitHub issue body of null is normalized to empty sealed issue-body evidence rather than rejected.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Production-adapter proof must feed a real-shaped null parent and child body through createGhJsonTransportV1 and acquisition and observe zero-byte digest-bound evidence.

classes.name: EvidenceAdmissionContainment
classes.owner: AssistedCall validation and acquisition to Navigator evidence-loader seam
classes.boundary: Evidence identities are unique including generated IDs; declared files are canonical regular bounded descriptor reads; handles cannot escape their admitted capability; snapshot validation rejects duplicate IDs; admitted bytes cannot change after digest validation.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Use the existing evidence admission seam with a single explicit size bound and immutable byte ownership. Production-seam proof must cover generated-ID collisions duplicate snapshot IDs non-string/noncanonical paths FIFO/device and oversized files descriptor-race resistance absolute/traversal handle escape valid package-generated and declared handles and post-admission Uint8Array mutation.

classes.name: SelectedSettlementEvidenceTruth
classes.owner: Recorder-selected-role settlement to post-settlement acquisition seam
classes.boundary: Navigator can read the sealed accepted Receipt or failure artifact for the latest selected attempt and terminal classification preserves role-specific outcomes including Judge escalation.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Admit the verified settlement artifact exactly once as digest-bound evidence and classify Judge judgeStatus without guessing from a common status field. Production-seam proof must distinguish Judge converged continue and escalate plus refusal infrastructure and recovered outcomes in the post-settlement Navigator input.

classes.name: RecorderArtifactAuthenticity
classes.owner: Recorder docket publication and Assisted Recorder transport live/recovery seam
classes.boundary: Only a schema-valid manifest with verified receipt session artifact lengths digests identity joins and exact child exit/signal truth can become a Runner settlement.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Reuse one verified docket loader for live and readSealed paths; do not trust receipt.json session bytes or the manifest hash alone. Production-seam proof must tamper each join digest and byte length and must run children that submit a receipt then exit nonzero or receive a signal; these must retain exact infrastructure/cancellation truth and never become accepted role or Navigator outcomes.

classes.name: RecoveryStateContinuity
classes.owner: Assisted Runner reservation recovery and same-call replay seam
classes.boundary: Recovered lost role attempts remain the durable latest attempt; a pre-spawn action reservation is resumable without duplicate launch; an already-settled post-navigation consultation completes replay without another consultation or misidentifying preNavigation.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Represent recovery in the existing ledger truth rather than a transient acquisition local. Production-seam barriers must kill between action_reserved and role_started after recovered publication and after navigator_settled before call_completed; prove one selected invocation identity one post-consultation durable latestAttempt and correct pre/post receipts across later calls.

classes.name: LedgerTemporaryPublicationSafety
classes.boundary: One appender never deletes another live temporary file and unexpected cleanup failures remain visible while true generation losers surface as AssistedLedgerConflictError.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Remove unconditional peer-temp deletion or clean only provably abandoned files; do not mask non-ENOENT errors. Production filesystem-barrier proof must hold one temp open start a second append and verify one canonical winner plus a typed conflict loser not ENOENT; inject cleanup permission/I/O failure and assert causal preservation.

classes.name: EvidencePagingCoverage
classes.owner: Navigator evidence reader and Recorder sealed-read reconstruction seam
classes.boundary: Valid UTF-8 is readable at byte page boundaries; coverage is recorded only after successful reads; both live and reconstructed coverage use bounded merged intervals rather than per-byte sets.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Preserve byte offsets and truthful fullyRead semantics without a second coverage tracker. Production-seam proof must cover split multibyte code points failed decode with no read credit overlapping adjacent sparse and empty ranges and large bounded evidence through both NavigatorEvidenceStore and sealedEvidenceReads live/readSealed paths.

classes.name: NavigatorReceiptContract
classes.owner: Navigator canonical Receipt validator and Recorder terminating-tool contract seam
classes.boundary: Every recorded receipt and nested decision citation is completely shape identity binding and evidence validated; a refused defect evidenceId must belong to the admitted read citation set.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Share structural primitives without weakening snapshot-bound validateNavigatorReceiptV1. Production-seam proof must reject malformed UUIDv7 digest cursor subject latestAttempt explanation evidenceRead and primary variants at Recorder extraction/recovery and reject unknown unread or top-level-disagreeing nested refused evidenceId.

classes.name: AssistedInputContractClosure
classes.owner: AssistedCall and public run-locator admission seam
classes.boundary: Workspace/evidence paths are strings and canonical; environment unset names are spawn-safe unique and disjoint from overrides; child and explicit parent issue numbers are positive safe integers; every public locator validates root runId parentIssue and applicable call identity before path construction or ledger publication.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Reuse Recorder-compatible environment law and the shared run locator. Production-seam proof must exercise public TypeScript and CLI entry points with arrays coercible paths traversal malformed UUIDs zero/negative children and parent values duplicate/illegal/overlapping unset entries and show rejection before filesystem access ledger facts or spawn.

classes.name: SchemaContractParity
classes.owner: Published JSON schemas and runtime tool-schema exports
classes.boundary: Schemas are closed complete and behaviorally equivalent to runtime validators including role-phase conditionals and all Navigator primary variants.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Complete schemas/assisted-call-v1.schema.json schemas/navigator-receipt-v1.schema.json and assistedCallConfigV1Schema or remove an unsupported runtime export. Production-schema proof must accept every valid role/status variant and reject cross-role phases missing variant fields and extra nested properties through the actual schema consumer.

classes.name: NavigatorActivationAtomicity
classes.owner: Navigator role activation and tool registration seam
classes.boundary: Activation failure exposes neither a prior/new active snapshot nor a partially registered tool state and successful activation commits exactly the required two tools atomically from the runtime perspective.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Preflight names build replacement state locally and assign active/registered only after registration and narrowing checks. Production-runtime proof must inject soul snapshot evidence first/second registration and active-tool verification failures then prove fail-closed behavior and a legal corrected activation where the host permits it.

classes.name: TypedMachineControlFlow
classes.owner: Assisted recovery control flow and regression-test oracle boundary
classes.boundary: Production routing never recognizes free-text error wording and tests do not use presentation prose where typed details or simple rejection are the real contract.
classes.disposition: OPEN. Replace the recovered-message comparison with a typed signal. In tests assert evidence details and typed conflict classes; where no public error taxonomy is required assert rejection rather than inventing production error codes. Keep prompt prose tests only for an exact genuinely versioned prompt contract not regex wording.
